name: Fleecemane Lion
oracle_text:
{3}{G}{W}: Monstrosity 1. (If this creature isn't monstrous, put a +1/+1 counter on it and it becomes monstrous.)
As long as this creature is monstrous, it has hexproof and indestructible.
blocked_sentences: As long as this creature is monstrous, it has hexproof and indestructible.

needs.what: a static-condition leaf (e.g. {"monstrous": true}) reading GameObject.monstrous on the static's own source, so a grant_keyword static can switch on "as long as this creature is monstrous"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The monstrosity op sets GameObject.monstrous, a dedicated field deliberately not folded into `flags`, so the static condition `has_flag` cannot see it; `counters` (+1/+1 >= 1) is wrong because counters can come from elsewhere or be removed; a becomes_monstrous trigger doing set_flag is an unprinted trigger that uses the stack, leaving a window where the creature is monstrous without hexproof/indestructible
